## Review checklist
- [ ] Official/primary source used where available.
- [ ] Jurisdiction is not inferred from an airport or map point.
- [ ] Legal status and effective date are distinguished.
- [ ] Original language is preserved.
- [ ] Translation status is labeled.
- [ ] Privacy, safety, and copyright reviewed.
- [ ] Uncertainty and limitations documented.
- [ ] JSON validates against the current schema, if applicable.
